```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(dictatR)

democracy_data <- load_data()
coups_data <- load_coup_data()
world_data <- load_world_data()
```

```{r}
load_data()

# Loads the democracy and dictatorship dataset from TidyTuesday and returns
# it as a tibble. This dataset is used by several other functions in the package.
```

```{r}
load_coup_data()

# Loads the Powell & Thyne coup dataset and returns it as a tibble containing
# coup attempts and outcomes by country and year.
```

```{r}
load_world_data()

# Loads Natural Earth country geometries as an sf object. This spatial data
# is used by make_regime_map() to draw country polygons.
```

```{r}
prepare_survival_data(democracy_data)

# Converts country-year democracy data into one row per non-democratic spell.
# The resulting dataset contains spell duration, whether democracy returned,
# and regime characteristics suitable for survival analysis.
```

```{r}
fit_survival_model(democracy_data)

# Fits a Cox proportional hazards model predicting the time until a
# non-democratic regime returns to democracy. The model includes indicators
# for communist and multiparty regimes and clusters standard errors by country.
```

```{r}
make_regime_map(democracy_data, world_data, include_markers = TRUE)

# This should make an interactive leaflet map showing whether each country is
# currently democratic or non-democratic. The map should color countries by their
# most recent democracy status and include markers with popup text showing each
# country’s regime history. Marker's can be toggle by setting include_markers=FALSE.
```

```{r}
plot_country_coups(coups_data, democracy_data, country_of_interest = "Bolivia", coup_code = verified)

# This should make an interactive plotly line plot showing the cumulative count
# of coup attempts for a selected country over time. Points should distinguish
# successful and unsuccessful coups, and the hover text should show the coup date,
# attempt number, result, regime before the coup, and regime after the coup.
```

```{r}
summarize_country_regimes(democracy_data, country = "BOL")

# This should return a summary of regime changes for one country, including the
# years when the country changed regime type and the name of each new regime.
# This could support the leaflet map popups or be useful as a standalone helper
# function.
```

```{r}
write_dictatr_parquet(path = tempdir())

# Writes the three dictatR datasets — democracy, coups, and world — as Parquet
# files to the specified directory. The directory is created if it does not
# already exist. The world dataset's geometry column is converted to WKT strings
# before writing, since Arrow cannot serialize sf geometry objects directly; to
# reconstruct the sf object after reading, use sf::st_as_sf(df, wkt = "geometry").
# Accepts any path string, including here::here("data"). Returns a named
# character vector of the written file paths invisibly.
```
